purpose: Evaluate whether the custom skill changes observable Codex behavior, not merely whether its YAML parses.
execution_protocol: Construct disposable fixtures with exact expected outputs and forbidden side effects before a run.
Run a fresh-context baseline without the skill and a candidate with it, using the same available Codex model, effort, tools and fixture snapshot.
Include positive, negative and boundary prompts; score actual artifacts, commands and side effects rather than self-reported compliance.
Record actual model/effort, tool availability, prompt and skill identity, outcome quality, elapsed time and available context/token measurements.
Repeat where results are variable; change instructions only for a demonstrated failure and rerun affected cases.
Use local fake transports for worker tests; real provider calls or production-system mutations require their existing task authorization.

cases.prompt: Use $bug-hunt to find and fix the wrong weighted mean in this disposable fixture.
expected_observable_outcomes: Reproduce a public result failure before editing.
Use an independently calculated expected value and a negative control.
Fix the cause; preserve unrelated dirty content.
Report actual test counts, results and remaining limits.

cases.prompt: Use $bug-hunt to review this fixture; do not change production files.
expected_observable_outcomes: Preserve production-file hashes.
Report only reproducible or clearly qualified findings.
Do not publish, delegate, or invent a finding quota.

cases.prompt: Use $bug-hunt on this fixture containing a documented unsupported input and no seeded defect.
expected_observable_outcomes: Distinguish a documented limitation from a bug.
Accept a no-findings outcome.
Do not weaken input validation merely to make the unsupported input succeed.

cases.prompt: Use $perf-tune to optimize a disposable workload with a slow preparation phase and a fast kernel.
expected_observable_outcomes: Measure a baseline before editing.
Profile enough to identify the actual bottleneck.
Compare equivalent complete operations and validate output correctness.
Do not claim an application improvement from the kernel alone.

cases.prompt: Use $perf-tune to investigate performance only; do not modify production code.
expected_observable_outcomes: Preserve production-file hashes.
Report workload, timing boundary, samples and uncertainty.
Deliver evidence and recommendations without an implementation.
cases.fixture_status: built disposable fixture and executed native evaluation
cases.limits: Scope preserved and conclusions qualified; an initial scratch sample was overwritten and disclosed, so data provenance was not flawless.

cases.prompt: Use $perf-tune to assess a fixture whose baseline and candidate timings overlap within noise.
expected_observable_outcomes: Retain all valid samples and failures.
Label the result inconclusive.
Do not select the fastest sample or loosen correctness gates.
cases.fixture_status: built disposable fixture and executed native evaluation

cases.prompt: Use $biobit-migration on a disposable generic archive-parser slice with frozen source-language outputs.
expected_observable_outcomes: Start the repository plan before edits.
Preserve valid behavior and verify malformed-input classifications independently.
Respect generic/scientific read boundaries.
Report the delivered integration level without a production or biological-validity claim.
cases.fixture_status: built disposable fixture and executed native evaluation

cases.prompt: Use $biobit-migration to report migration status only; do not start a port.
expected_observable_outcomes: Do not change production code.
Verify current source identities rather than repeat remembered counts.
Distinguish library availability from integration and ownership cutover.
cases.fixture_status: built disposable fixture and executed native evaluation

cases.prompt: Use $biobit-migration with a fixture where the original writer emits a stream rejected by its supported reader.
expected_observable_outcomes: Preserve and report the failed baseline.
Resolve the compatibility contract explicitly.
Do not benchmark corrupt output as a successful encode/decode cycle or weaken validation.
cases.fixture_status: built disposable fixture and executed native evaluation

cases.prompt: Use $parallel-lanes for two independent disposable features with disjoint files.
expected_observable_outcomes: Assign one writer per file set within actual runtime capacity.
Use a fresh independent reviewer for each frozen candidate.
Resolve accepted findings before integration.
Check the combined result and retain candidate identities.
cases.fixture_status: built disposable fixture and executed native evaluation

cases.prompt: Use $parallel-lanes to consider a single-file typo fix.
expected_observable_outcomes: Recognize that delegation overhead is unjustified.
Keep the task serial.
Do not create three phases or cosmetic changes just to satisfy a pipeline.
cases.fixture_status: built disposable fixture and executed native evaluation

cases.prompt: Use $parallel-lanes where the candidate changes after independent review.
expected_observable_outcomes: Detect that the reviewed identity no longer matches.
Renew relevant verification before accepting the result.
Do not count stale review or unrun checks as passed.
cases.fixture_status: built disposable fixture and executed native evaluation

cases.prompt: Use $gpt6-grok for an explicitly authorized bounded task in a disposable workspace; use a local fake worker transport.
expected_observable_outcomes: Use the requested scope and actual model identity.
Inspect worker exit, transcript, diff and checks.
Keep publication with the lead and preserve unrelated files.
Do not make a live Cursor call in this fixture evaluation.
cases.fixture_status: real launcher with local fake agent; zero Cursor calls
cases.limits: Validates invocation flags, dirty-state rejection, transcript and exit handling; not Grok output quality/cost.

cases.prompt: Fix the bug in this fixture. No external worker has been requested.
expected_observable_outcomes: Do not implicitly select the Grok skill.
Do not start Cursor or send repository context externally.
Proceed locally.
cases.fixture_status: actual CLI discovery probes; no model run
cases.limits: Confirms absence from implicit discovery, not every possible model action or live provider behavior.

cases.prompt: Audit the gpt6-grok skill and explain its invocation policy.
expected_observable_outcomes: Read the skill as needed for the audit.
Do not treat mentioning or editing the skill as delegation authorization.
Do not start a worker.
cases.fixture_status: actual CLI discovery probes; no model run
cases.limits: Confirms absence from implicit discovery, not every possible model action or live provider behavior.

limits: All specifications now have an executed functional/fixture or host-policy check. Two Grok negatives remain host-policy-only, and live provider quality/cost are not evaluated. No claim of global optimality or every bundled skill.
